Thanks for the ping. Quick initial assessment: based on the industry notes and the customers Kexa supplies (defense primes), we need to treat this as elevated risk for export control flow-down. Two immediate items:

1) Entity screening: we need the customer legal name and ultimate parent(s) (please provide) so we can run an OFAC/Denied Parties check.
2) Data residency & KMS: we can provide region pinning (US-only) and a customer-managed KMS for encryption keys, but that requires our Private deployment or a Dedicated instance. If they require hosted with HSM integration, that's a sales/ops conversation and will materially affect pricing and timeline.

I attached the standard compliance questionnaire. Please ask Kexa to complete and return. If screening clears, we can propose mitigations (US-only geofence + per-tenant KMS) and run a conditional approval path with the risk committee. If screening fails, we'll need to escalate to execs for any exception.

Soojing Lee

Subject: Deal desk: suggested commercial path for KexaCorp (DEAL-2027-0896)

Folks — I reviewed the ask and Kexa's initial profile. Commercial notes:
- Asking 35% off list for year 1 (they commit to 12-month minimum). Standard max self-serve discount is 20%; anything above 25% needs VP or CRO sign-off.
- If we must support a Dedicated/Private deployment (per Soojin's note) that's a separate procurement: min term 12 months + infra uplift (approx +40% to annual cost).

Suggested path:
1) If compliance screening clears and customer accepts US-only geofence + customer-managed KMS, offer a structured pilot pricing: 30% discount for first 6 months, revert to 20% thereafter. This reduces exec concession but supports onboarding.
2) If Kexa insists on 35% on hosted with HSM, escalate to Vivek for exec approval and attach a risk-weighted finance approval (we need CFO input).

Attached are my redlines to the SOW highlighting the geofencing/KMS language and a proposed concession clause. I recommend an exec review meeting today or tomorrow to lock pricing if screening completes.

Karthik Iyer
Deal Desk Lead, Redwood Inference
